# M.I. Engineering Works — full product reference

Manufacturer, supplier and exporter of ASTM A193 Grade B7 industrial fasteners.
Address: 301, 01, Mehar Iron Bazar, Iron Market, Khedwadi, Girgaon, Mumbai 400004, Maharashtra, India

Hours: Mon-Sat 9:00-19:00 IST. ISO 9001:2015 compliant, EN 10204 3.1 certificates.

## Stud Bolts

URL: https://miengineeringworks.com/product.html?slug=stud-bolts
Category: Studs
Standard: ASME B16.5 / DIN 976
Material: ASTM A193 Grade B7 (42CrMo4 / AISI 4140)
Sizes: M6 to M100 | 1/4" to 4"
Threads: Metric (Coarse & Fine) | UNC / UNF | BSW / BSF
Length: 30mm to 3000mm | Custom lengths available
Grades: B7, B7M, B16, L7, L7M, B8, B8M, Grade 10.9, Grade 12.9
Finishes: Plain / Black Oxide, Hot Dip Galvanized, Zinc Plated, PTFE / Xylan Coated, Cadmium Plated
Applications: Flange Connections, Pressure Vessels, Heat Exchangers, Pipelines, Refineries, Power Plants

Fully threaded or partially threaded stud bolts manufactured from ASTM A193 Grade B7 chromium-molybdenum steel. Designed for high-temperature, high-pressure flange connections in petrochemical, oil & gas, and power generation industries.

Technical data:
- Diameter Range: M6 – M100
- Length Range: 30mm – 3000mm
- Thread Pitch: As per standard
- Tensile Strength: 860 MPa (min)
- Yield Strength: 720 MPa (min)
- Hardness: 235–302 HB

- Head Height: 3mm – 48mm
- Socket Size: 2.5mm – 36mm

- Hardness: 280–365 HB
